page.overview:
Who is Harp Allor?

Harp Allor was a human female from the planet Chandrila who lived during the era of the Galactic Empire. Sponsored by Winmey Lenz, a Chandrilan senior senator, Allor became a member of the Apprentice Legislature in 3 BBY. She was described by fellow Apprentice Legislator Princess Leia Organa as being friendly, over-prepared, and unabashedly cheerful, and was one of several Apprentice Legislators to participate Chief Pangie's pathfinding class organized by Queen Breha Organa of Alderaan.

Harp Allor was born in 20 BBY. As part of the Apprentice Legislature, Harp Allor attended a pathfinding class arranged by Queen Breha Organa of Alderaan, alongside Princess Leia Organa, Chassellon Stevis, Sssamm Ashsssen, Amilyn Holdo, Kier Domadi, and an Ithorian, among many other students under the instruction of Chief Pangie of the Chandrilan Pathfinding Corps. The group hiked for five hours before finding a hoversled. Pangie told the students that it belonged to her, and that they must find their way back to the chalet by nightfall or be kicked from the class, before she departed.

As the group slowly made their way back, and Holdo looked for snow owls, they argued over the pace they should be going. Allor rushed ahead, but slipped on ice, breaking her left ankle. This caused the group to argue, with some wanting to help Allor and others wanting to continue on, since each student had a tracker which could be used to find Allor after they had made it back. Organa, Domadi, Ashsssen, and Holdo stayed with Allor while Stevis led the rest of the class onward. The four managed to splint and bandage Allor's ankle and get her onto a travois to drag her back to the chalet. When Holdo joked they had encountered mortal peril, Allor began to cry, apologizing for slowing the group down. Domadi comforted her and they soon arrived at a snow-covered slope. Holdo came up with the idea of making a toboggan out of a tent, and Ashsssen held it together.

Stevis along with his group arrived at sunset, and when they walked into the great room, they shocked to see that the five had made it before him with the injured Allor and were resting by the hearth and drinking mocoa, Allor resting her left foot on a sleeping Ashsssen in the comfiest chair by the fire, floaty cream on the tip of her nose and a bacta bag on her foot. Pangie also lectured Stevis and the others for their abandonment of Harp.
